events.body:
## Context

`public/css/fontawesome.min.css` loads `../webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2`, `fa-regular-400.woff2` and `fa-brands-400.woff2`, but only `public/webfonts/fa-v4compatibility.woff2` is committed. The live site 404s on the fonts, so every icon shows as an empty box (index.html alone uses 15 solid icons).

## What to do

1. Copy the three woff2 files from `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` (already a devDependency; match the version in the CSS header) into `public/webfonts/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The three files are in `public/webfonts/`
- [ ] No webfont 404s in DevTools on index, workspace and finding pages
- [ ] Icons visible in light and dark mode

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-ketchup/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
